body: #Crash outputs like this are not very informative. Try launching with `--verbose` to see at what point crash happens
If its crashing with OpenGL too, than it is most likely an issue with your friend's setup. Do they have the GPU installed properly? Including having all necessary drivers installed?

Hey there! Thanks for the answers.

My friend installed Arch Linux using archinstall, with all open source drivers for graphics. Later, he installed the current Nvidia open driver using:

```sudo pacman -S nvidia-open-dkms nvidia-settings libva-nvidia-driver linux-headers linux-lts-headers```

So far, we haven't noticed any issues with other applications. Even Steam games are running normally.

He ran Godots (Flatpak) using the --verbose option. Below is the result. The crash happens with any Godot version (even directly downloading from the website).
